column1: # DuoBites architecture
## Overview
DuoBites is a layered system for analyzing suspicious online activity. The first MVP focuses on a reliable workflow rather than on high-volume production performance.
## Layers
1. Data ingestion
- CSV uploads are validated before analysis.
- Synthetic sample datasets allow local testing without private data.
2. Feature and signal services
- Bot detection uses a baseline scikit-learn classifier.
- Claim analysis uses uncertainty-aware evidence logic.
- Coordination detection uses NetworkX to group similar activity.
3. Risk aggregation
- Individual signals are combined into an explainable score.
- Missing evidence is explicitly described instead of filled with invented values.
4. API layer
- FastAPI exposes upload and analysis endpoints.
- API documentation is generated automatically by FastAPI.
5. Frontend dashboard
- A React dashboard consumes the API and visualizes risk signals.
- The dashboard is intentionally simple to keep the project beginner-friendly.
## Design principles
- Human review first
- Evidence-based conclusions
- Explainability over black-box decisions
- Safe sample data only
- Modular services to keep the project maintainable
